Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.4: Writing 3.4.1 Mechanics of Writing Handwriting Joined/Cursive script)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 3.4.1 Mechanics of Writing Handwriting Joined/Cursive script), part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: Why should we write legibly and neatly? 2. How can you improve your handwriting?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 3.4.1 Mechanics of Writing Handwriting Joined/Cursive script) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination: Communication and self-expression as learner uses visuals to compose a story of about 120 to 160 words.

• Digital Literacy: Interacting with digital devices as learner uses internet resources to search for information.

Values:
Social justice: Responsibility as learners write compositions based on the observed visuals/pictures.

Link to other Subjects:

Learners are able to relate the skill of legible handwriting to learning in all learning areas.
